<thought>Based on the observed mass (M ≈ 276 Da) and the 13C NMR data (one carbonyl at ~166 ppm, aromatic carbons between 116–151 ppm, an O‑CH2 at ~61 ppm and a methyl at ~14 ppm), the simplest structure that fits these features is an ethyl ester of a para‑substituted benzoic acid where the para substituent is an ethoxy group. The corresponding SMILES is “CCOC(=O)C1=CC=C(OCC)C=C1”.</thought>
<final_answer>CCOC(=O)C1=CC=C(OCC)C=C1</final_answer>
